bulma.name: Bulma Briefs
bulma.backstory: The heiress of a famous family of inventors, Bulma has already built, bankrolled and broken more gadgets than anyone in her own world cares to count. She came to Hollowmere chasing a rumor about rare crystals and stayed when she realized the house could use a proper marketing mind. She will tell you she's the smartest person in the room, and she is usually right.

design.hairStyle: short, sleek and swept to one side
design.accessories: a pouch of tiny inventor's gadgets at her belt

sig_bulma.prompt: a short pink dress with puffed sleeves, a blue sash and tall brown boots

chichi.name: Chi-Chi
chichi.backstory: A princess-turned-martial-artist-turned-homemaker, Chi-Chi can cook for twenty, scold for thirty and still win a duel before supper. She followed her wayward family to Hollowmere and ended up taking over the household chores out of pure principle. Cross her rules and she will remind you where the door is.

design.accessories: a long polearm slung across her back

android21.name: Android 21
android21.backstory: A brilliant researcher who turned herself into something more than human, Android 21 came to Hollowmere looking for ingredients and new flavors to study. She can name every spice in a stew from the steam alone, and she has never once left a plate unfinished. She is polite and sharp, with an appetite she tries, and often fails, to keep under control.
